title: Add cloud storage functionality with Vercel KV integration in studio
body:
## Migration Plan: Vite + React Router → Next.js App Router

### Context
The studio needs cloud service save functionality. Currently using localStorage, but to enable cloud saves, we need:
- Backend API routes for CRUD operations
- Database integration for persistent storage
- Authentication for user-specific designs
- Sharing capabilities

### Why Next.js App Router?
- ✅ Built-in API routes (no separate backend needed)
- ✅ Server Components for better performance
- ✅ Server Actions for form submissions
- ✅ Easy authentication integration (NextAuth.js)
- ✅ File-based routing (similar to current React Router)
- ✅ Better SEO for landing/gallery pages
- ✅ Modern framework aligned with React ecosystem

### Implementation Checklist

- [x] Setup: Create Next.js 15 app with App Router in apps/playground

  - [x] Create next.config.js with transpilePackages
  - [x] Update tsconfig.json for Next.js
  - [x] Create next-env.d.ts
  - [x] Update .gitignore for Next.js
  - [x] Update postcss.config.js for CommonJS
- [x] Migration: Convert React Router pages to App Router structure
  - [x] Create app/layout.tsx (root layout with Toaster)
  - [x] Create app/page.tsx (Home/gallery page)
  - [x] Create app/my-designs/page.tsx (user designs list)
  - [x] Create components/StudioClient.tsx (Studio editor component)
  - [x] Create app/studio/[id]/page.tsx (dynamic route wrapper)

  - [x] Copy src/services to lib/
  - [x] Copy src/data to lib/
  - [x] Update all imports to use @ aliases
- [x] Fix Build Issues

  - [x] DELETE /api/designs/:id - Delete design

- [ ] Documentation: Update README and deployment guide

### API Routes Implemented

The following REST API endpoints have been created with proper Next.js 15 async params support:

- **GET /api/designs** - List all saved designs
- **POST /api/designs** - Create a new design (requires `name` and `schema`)
- **GET /api/designs/:id** - Retrieve a single design by ID
- **PUT /api/designs/:id** - Update an existing design
- **DELETE /api/designs/:id** - Delete a design
- **POST /api/designs/:id/share** - Generate a shareable link for a design
- **GET /api/designs/shared/:shareId** - Retrieve a shared design

All endpoints use a centralized `serverStorage` module (`lib/serverStorage.ts`) for storage operations.

### Vercel KV Integration

The storage layer now supports both Vercel KV (for production persistence) and in-memory fallback (for local development):

**Features:**
- ✅ Automatic KV detection via environment variables
- ✅ Graceful fallback to in-memory storage when KV is unavailable
- ✅ Error handling with automatic fallback on KV operation failures
- ✅ Redis-like data structure with prefixed keys (`design:*`, `shared:*`)
- ✅ Async storage operations throughout all API routes

**Setup:**
- Add `@vercel/kv` package dependency
- Environment variables automatically configured in Vercel
- Local development works without KV configuration
- Detailed setup guide available in `VERCEL_KV_SETUP.md`

**Storage Strategy:**
- **Production (Vercel with KV)**: Persistent cloud storage using Vercel KV
- **Local Development**: Automatic in-memory fallback for seamless development
- **Resilience**: Falls back to in-memory if KV operations fail

See `apps/playground/VERCEL_KV_SETUP.md` for complete setup instructions including how to create a KV database in Vercel, configure environment variables, and test locally.
